The '''Thrasybule sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was bordered by the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]], [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth]], [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras]], [[Rolion sector/Legends|Rolion]], and the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Planets within Thrasybule included [[Syndaar]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Thrasybule was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ghundrak]].
